beats.goal: Establish Vane's return from war, his hunger for legacy, and the Moor's ominous presence
beats.conflict: Vane's lands are ruined; his father dead; the Moor whispers at the edge of his estate
beats.outcome: Vane rides to Wyrmwood Moor seeking the Weird Sisters, dismissing local warnings

beats.goal: First encounter with the Three Sisters; receive the first prophecy
beats.conflict: The Sisters speak in riddles; Vane demands clarity; they name a price — a drop of blood
beats.outcome: Prophecy: 'You shall hold the land that drinks the king's blood.' Vane bleeds into the chalice

beats.goal: Introduce Lieutenant Corwin as foil; show Vane's growing obsession
beats.conflict: Corwin urges return to duty; Vane interprets prophecy as promise of kingship
beats.outcome: Vane sends Corwin away with a letter to the king — a calculated move toward treason

beats.goal: Introduce Father Anselm; establish the Moor's history and the Sisters' true nature
beats.conflict: Anselm warns Vane: the Sisters don't predict, they engineer; Vane threatens him
beats.outcome: Anselm gives Vane a blessed iron nail — 'for when the thread pulls tight'

beats.goal: Second prophecy; Vane manipulates events to fulfill it
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'The loyal blade shall turn at the third crow.' Vane engineers a scenario
beats.outcome: Corwin refuses to kill a prisoner; Vane frames it as betrayal; Corwin is arrested

beats.goal: Introduce Mara, a prior victim; reveal the cost of the Sisters' bargains
beats.conflict: Mara finds Vane; shows her missing tongue; warns him the prophecy is a snare
beats.outcome: Vane dismisses her as mad; but keeps the iron nail close

beats.goal: Third prophecy; Vane commits his first murder to secure the path
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'The crown passes through a brother's heart.' Vane's half-brother visits
beats.outcome: Vane poisons his half-brother; the death looks natural; Vane inherits the title

beats.goal: The Sisters reveal the Weave — show Vane the threads of his future
beats.conflict: Vane sees his rise but not the end; the Sisters refuse to show the final thread
beats.outcome: Vane demands the final prophecy; they agree — for his true name spoken willingly

beats.goal: Vane speaks his true name; receives the fourth prophecy
beats.conflict: The name binds him; Prophecy: 'No blade of woman born shall end you'
beats.outcome: Vane feels invincible; begins open rebellion; the Moor's mist spreads to his lands

beats.goal: Act 1 climax — Vane's forces march; the first harvest begins
beats.conflict: King's army approaches; Vane realizes the prophecy required his rebellion
beats.outcome: Vane wins the battle but Corwin escapes; the Sisters whisper: 'One thread cut'

beats.goal: Vane consolidates power; the Moor's influence grows
beats.conflict: Crops fail; livestock birth monstrosities; soldiers hear whispers in the mist
beats.outcome: Vane executes dissenters; the Sisters appear in his war tent, measuring thread

beats.goal: Fifth prophecy; a false security that masks a trap
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'Wyrmwood's heart shall shield you till the forest walks'
beats.outcome: Vane fortifies the Moor; cuts down sacred trees; the forest bleeds black sap

beats.goal: Corwin returns with Anselm and Mara; they know the Sisters' weakness
beats.conflict: Anselm reveals the Sisters need a willing vessel for the Harvest; Vane is the vessel
beats.outcome: Vane imprisons them; but doubt seeds — he dreams of threads around his throat

beats.goal: Sixth prophecy; Vane's paranoia turns him against his own officers
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'The closest hand shall deal the deepest wound'
beats.outcome: Vane kills his most loyal captain; the man's dying words: 'You did this to yourself'

beats.goal: Mara escapes; reveals the Sisters' origin — they were once human, bound to the Moor
beats.conflict: Mara steals Vane's blood-sample from the Sisters' chalice; the contract can be broken
beats.outcome: Vane hunts her; she flees into the Moor; the Sisters laugh — 'The mouse runs to the trap'

beats.goal: Seventh prophecy; the king's army surrounds Wyrmwood
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'Fire shall not touch you, nor water drown, nor earth swallow'
beats.outcome: Vane walks through the siege unharmed; but his men die by the hundreds

beats.goal: Anselm performs a ritual to sever one thread; partial success
beats.conflict: The ritual requires a sacrifice; Anselm offers his own sight
beats.outcome: One prophecy fractures — 'No blade of woman born' now reads 'No blade... born'

beats.goal: Vane confronts the Sisters; demands the final prophecy
beats.conflict: They refuse unless he brings them the heart of one who loves him
beats.outcome: Vane realizes no one loves him; he rides to find Mara — the only one who tried to save him

beats.goal: Vane finds Mara; she offers her heart willingly to break the contract
beats.conflict: Mara: 'I loved the man you were. Kill me, and you kill him forever'
beats.outcome: Vane cannot kill her; he brings her to the Sisters alive — 'Take her instead'

beats.goal: Act 2 climax — The Sisters accept Mara; the final prophecy is spoken
beats.conflict: Prophecy: 'The harvest comes when the sower becomes the seed'
beats.outcome: Maw cuts Mara's thread; Spindle spins Vane's name into the Weave; Shear smiles

beats.goal: Vane realizes the truth — every prophecy was a step toward this moment
beats.conflict: The 'king's blood' was his half-brother's (royal bastard); 'forest walks' = his men carrying wood
beats.outcome: Vane's mind fractures; he sees the Weave — his entire life a pattern woven by the Sisters

beats.goal: Corwin leads the assault on the Moor; the forest does walk
beats.conflict: The trees move; roots drag men down; the Moor fights for the Sisters
beats.outcome: Corwin reaches the standing stones; Vane waits with the iron nail

beats.goal: Vane and Corwin's final confrontation; brother against brother
beats.conflict: Corwin begs Vane to break the contract; Vane cannot — his name is woven in
beats.outcome: Corwin wounds Vane with a blade forged from cold iron — 'Not of woman born, but of earth'

beats.goal: The Sisters reveal the final truth: Vane was never the king — he was the sacrifice
beats.conflict: The Harvest requires a soul who sought power and found only ruin
beats.outcome: The Moor swallows Vane's army; the mist takes shape — thousands of prior harvests

beats.goal: Anselm's final ritual; he burns his own life to sever the Weave
beats.conflict: The Sisters attack Anselm; he holds the line long enough
beats.outcome: The Weave tears; Vane feels the threads snap; the Sisters scream — a sound like tearing silk

beats.goal: Vane's moment of choice — take the Sisters' offer of power, or destroy the loom
beats.conflict: Maw offers: 'Rule the Moor. Weave your own fate.' Spindle: 'Live forever.' Shear: 'Never die.'
beats.outcome: Vane drives the iron nail into the central loom-stone; the Moor shrieks

beats.goal: The Moor collapses; the Sisters unravel; Vane holds the tear open for others to escape
beats.conflict: The ground swallows the standing stones; Mara's body dissolves into light
beats.outcome: Corwin drags Vane clear; the Moor becomes a mundane bog; the Sisters are gone

beats.goal: Aftermath — Vane lives but is broken; the cost of the harvest
beats.conflict: Vane's wound won't heal; he sees threads everywhere; cannot rule, cannot fight
beats.outcome: Vane abdicates to Corwin; retires to a monastery at the Moor's edge

beats.goal: Epilogue — years later; a new soldier rides toward the Moor
beats.conflict: The Moor is quiet, but a single thread glints in the mist
beats.outcome: Vane watches from the monastery window; his fingers twitch toward the iron nail

beats.goal: Final image — the cycle continues; the harvest never ends
beats.conflict: A voice in the wind: 'We sow no seed, yet harvest every soul'
beats.outcome: Vane closes the shutters. The nail grows warm in his pocket. The end.
